ReviewedInteractions.Rationale: The new inline loader at RVA 0x18EB20 is in the target-selection function at 0x18E9A0. ImprovedHunters' manual command check begins at 0x18EB36, after the two complete overwritten loader instructions ending at 0x18EB2F; its target dispatch hook is at 0x18F2CA. The projects consume separate points of the same function.

The 2.10.1 hotfix adds an attacker-type capture at RVA 0x19B64E and retains the range-table loader at 0x19B786 inside the native function at 0x19B630. The capture stores the sign-extended type in unused stack shadow space for the later loader; the loader no longer derives it from unrelated registers. Our moat movement and cadence hooks near 0x19B506/0x19B554 and 0x19B260 are in separate earlier functions; no local or Fixes hook uses either patched site.

The new projectile initialization inline site is at RVA 0xA1E0E with a declared minimum hook size of 0x17; the installed RedBird backend rounds displacement to complete instructions. Local projectile consumers use manager APIs and a retained slot-view adapter; no release or Fixes hook patches this initialization block.

The 13 vtable-selected ranged-unit update functions are scanned for a compare of unit field 0x8FE. Fixes' optional wildlife hooks cover deer, lion, rabbit, camel, hyena, goat and crocodile function entries, disjoint from the ranged-unit set. Fixes' selection speed patches use field 0x916; no local release hook matches the new 0x8FE compare site.
The new interaction-range loader near RVA 0x8D769 is distinct from BugfixesAndQoL's attack-unit pair gate at 0x8D72B and peace-time patch at 0x8D7C4; no current mod enables the range override.
Existing call-site adapters consume the extender-owned Assassin result at RVA 0x196870 and preserve positive results; the 2.10 range hooks do not change that owned function.
The existing inline site at RVA 0x704CC remains nested in the original trampoline of the extender hook at RVA 0x6FE90; no new 2.10 hook changes either site.
